newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish May reserves rise to 108.8 bln Dkk.
newsitem.headline: Danish May reserves rise to 108.8 bln Dkk.

text.p: Denmark's foreign exchange reserves rose to 108.8 billion crowns at end-May 1997 from 101.8 billion crowns at end-April, according to the central bank's monthly balance sheet released on Tuesday.

NOTE - In a statement the Central Bank said it had paid back a net 0.2 billion crowns of foreign loans in May. Four analysts polled by Reuters had on average forecast Denmark's foreign reserves would rise to 109.9 billion crowns in May excluding net foreign loan transactions. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
